import asyncio,sys,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts')
from telethon_sessions import inspect,make_memory_client
from telethon.tl.functions.messages import GetChatInviteImportersRequest
from telethon.tl.types import InputUserEmpty
vault=Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads')
files=sorted(vault.glob('*.session'))
before=[hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).digest() for p in files]
config=inspect(vault)
async def run():
 client=make_memory_client(config['entries'][0],config)
 try:
  await asyncio.wait_for(client.connect(),timeout=25)
  if not await asyncio.wait_for(client.is_user_authorized(),timeout=20):
   print('OWNER_ACCOUNT_AUTHORISED',False)
   return
  print('OWNER_ACCOUNT_AUTHORISED',True)
  group=await asyncio.wait_for(client.get_entity(config['group']),timeout=20)
  print('TARGET_GROUP_IS_SUPERGROUP',bool(getattr(group,'megagroup',False)))
  rights=await asyncio.wait_for(client.get_permissions(group,'me'),timeout=20)
  admin=bool(getattr(rights,'is_creator',False) or (getattr(rights,'is_admin',False) and getattr(rights,'invite_users',False)))
  print('OWNER_CAN_MANAGE_JOIN_REQUESTS',admin)
  if admin:
   result=await asyncio.wait_for(client(GetChatInviteImportersRequest(peer=group,requested=True,offset_date=0,offset_user=InputUserEmpty(),limit=1)),timeout=25)
   count=getattr(result,'count',None)
   print('PENDING_JOIN_REQUESTS_TOTAL',count if type(count) is int else 'UNKNOWN')
 except Exception as e:
  print('OWNER_QUEUE_CHECK_STATUS',type(e).__name__)
 finally:
  if client.is_connected():await asyncio.wait_for(client.disconnect(),timeout=12)
asyncio.run(run())
assert before==[hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).digest() for p in files],'session_mutated'
print('SESSION_FILES_UNCHANGED',True)
print('OWNER_JOIN_QUEUE_READ_ONLY_COMPLETE')
